item.title: PostgreSQL 19 Is Out: Stop Piling On Features, Make Non-Stop Operations the Default
item.description: PostgreSQL 19 shipped on November 19, 2026. REPACK CONCURRENTLY shrinks bloated tables online without locking reads or writes, pg_plan_advice fixes bad plans without touching application code, WAIT FOR LSN makes read-your-writes on replicas a native database feature, logical replication no longer needs a restart, and sequences now replicate too. An original breakdown for DBAs and backend developers.
